caption: The drawing depicts a shallow, round ceramic dish shown from two perspectives: a top view and a side profile. The dish has a broad rim and a gently sloping side. The interior surface is decorated with two large floral motifs that feature brown petals and green leaves, surrounded by additional small green leaves and curling brown stems. The overall background color of the dish is a pale yellowish-cream, and the designs are rendered in brown and green hues. Around the rim, there are several concentric brown wavy lines, some accented with green spots. The exterior and underside of the dish, shown in the side profile beneath the top view, are colored in a similar brown tone. The drawing is made on an off-white background and includes a handwritten scale at the bottom, noting "SCALE: ABOUT 6.7" TO THE FOOT." The composition of the drawing is neat and precise, placing the dish centrally within a double-ruled rectangular border.
title: Pa. German Dish
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
